question: A projectile of mass $m$ and charge $q$ is launched from the ground with speed $v_0$ at an angle $\theta$ above the horizontal. Gravity acts downward with acceleration $g$. A uniform magnetic field is applied vertically upward, i.e. $\vec B = B\,\hat{j}$ (so $\vec B \parallel \vec g$). Neglect air resistance and any electric field. Determine the time $T$ after which the projectile returns to the ground (hits $y=0$ again).
